confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief. Radio at 09:30 says scoop LH-02 is stopped at C512-04, but CMMS OT-5001 shows it closed 20 min ago and operational. Confirm whether LH-02 is running. Nothing is moved for C512-04 until then.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-E595-06 (hydraulic). Radio and CMMS agree on this: OT-5100 is open, 3-5 h, repaired on site, so the loader is out for most of the shift. Este has 171 t in its stockpile and only LH-03 mucking (about 35.6 t/h). Este's 3 trucks (my estimate, about 73 t/h) can haul more than that, so Este is loader-limited and a replacement loader pays. E595-06 grade is 15.4 g/t with about 256 t of broken ore left (361 - 105). That is about 256 x 15.4 / 31.1 = 127 oz. Central has 4 trucks (about 90 t/h) against 4 or more loaders at 36-43 t/h each, plus 264 t in stockpile. It is truck-limited, so lending LH-06 from TJ-C564-01 (lowest grade, 5.8 g/t) costs almost nothing, and that stope's broken ore carries over. Travel for LH-06 is about 0.5 h (drift, ramp, surface, ramp, drift and 0.25 h manoeuvre). It has time to muck the remaining ore, at 43 t/h over about 6 h, before 17:00. I deduct about 10 oz for travel and truck limits, which gives about 115 oz. I did not take LH-09 (DS-E543-02, 4.0 oz/h, about 28 oz over the rest of the shift) or LH-07 (Norte, which has only that one loader). LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 (PM-01), so it is not available now. No reserve is activated because no stope is stopped.
